# GitHub Copilot instructions

Start with [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Follow [`GUIDELINES.md`](../GUIDELINES.md) for
coding and testing conventions and [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md) for design
decisions and constraints. Use the contribution and verification commands linked from
`AGENTS.md`.

When reviewing code, follow the procedure in
[`.claude/skills/code-quality/SKILL.md`](../.claude/skills/code-quality/SKILL.md): cite the file
and line, name the document section a finding rests on, and treat a template TODO as a gap rather
than guessing its content.

Base repository-specific guidance on those documents. If a convention is not documented,
do not present it as a repository rule.
